mg2_wolves_pup_1.m: Yelp - don't hurt us, big wolf.

achievements.1: Mikhail gave me a book in which I could put down my most unusual experiences and achievements.
achievements.10: On the road: My first glimpse of the great Duleian Road!
achievements.30: Prospector: I collected at least 100000 gold.
achievements.40: Birdwatching: I spotted a falcon high above the Lake Laeroth watchtower.
achievements.50: Lazy day: I spent a while watching a beetle fight.
achievements.60: The secret garden: Near Guynmart Castle, I found Rob's secret clearing.
achievements.70: Hole in the wall: I discovered a secret room deep in a cave.
achievements.80: Tough luck: I must have fallen for every trap in the Arulir mountain. Ouch ...
achievements.100: Swimming lessons: I swam along a raging river - and lived!
achievements.110: Overcoming fears: I braved the elements and my fear of heights and walked out onto the very edge of the Sullengard ravine and looked straight down to the ravine's bottom.
achievements.120: Thrown out of my first tavern: I was told to leave the Sullengard tavern and at such a young age too. Am I starting down the wrong path?
achievements.125: Uniform blue lighting: I solved a difficult logic riddle.
achievements.130: Nightmare Survived: I survived the most intense nightmares ever
achievements.135: Innocent barnyard animal dies: Even after the pig told me to stop feeding it rotten meat as it was making it sick, I continued to do so and it resulted in its death.
achievements.150: Exotic animal killed: On top of the hills south of Stoutford, I killed an exotic one-of-a-kind bird.
achievements.200: Sheep in wolf's clothing: I finally found a use for the Wolfpack's hide.
